file-system.output:
$ node read-async.js
This line runs BEFORE the file content is printed.
Welcome to the Node.js file system lab.
Asynchronous operations let other JavaScript continue while a file is being read.
Small command-line tools can save useful information in plain text files.

$ node read-sync.js
Welcome to the Node.js file system lab.
Asynchronous operations let other JavaScript continue while a file is being read.
Small command-line tools can save useful information in plain text files.
This line runs AFTER the file has been fully read.
